title: Getting started
description: Learn the page conventions, run the scripts, and record work that others can reproduce.

title: Complete known readings
description: Read each decoded section with its literal output, manuscript images, and reproduction instructions.

title: Runes and cipher methods
description: Understand rune representations and follow the transformations used in known readings.

title: Numbers and arithmetic
description: Distinguish prime values, indices, sums, and arithmetic functions before using them in a proposal.

title: Analysis and reproduction
description: Measure rune distributions and repeats, understand what a statistic can show, and reproduce the calculation.

title: Hidden content and verification
description: Extract embedded messages, follow the earlier puzzle chains, and verify files and signatures.

title: Page studies
description: Inspect particular headings, number panels, title images, and unresolved page details.

title: Philosophy and literary references
description: Compare manuscript passages and outside works, keeping interpretation separate from source attribution.

title: Artwork and visual features
description: Find a drawing or motif, inspect the preserved image, and follow the evidence for artwork identifications.
